range_gate_rule: <=70nm -> Pioneer II (N35 Shuttle on dense legs at scale); 75-150nm -> Quanta-LR (roadmap, amber); >150nm -> Quanta-LR flagged. Distances below are APPROXIMATE pending Grok seal on sealed BP coords; borderline (~65-72nm) legs are flagged for exact great-circle re-gate after seal.
demand_fare_note: Fares/volumes are SOURCE-ANCHORED ASSUMPTIONS for the model cascade, not sealed economics. Premium-tier fare + haircut-demand template (Bucket-C recipe). Economics are cascade-needed; nothing here is a final number.

demand_anchor.addressable: premium tourist + business slice of ferry+air pool

corridors.thesis: Island-to-island tourist circuit (Zanzibar + Mafia combo trips). Borderline range — flag for re-gate.

corridors.thesis: Bypasses the chronically congested Likoni channel ferry. Heavy daily commuter + tourist flow to the south-coast resort strip; road is 1.5-2h via Likoni queue today.
The Likoni channel itself: one of Africa's busiest ferry crossings (hundreds of thousands of daily crossings). High-frequency electric shuttle complement. Volume-heavy, low-fare.

demand_anchor.basis: Likoni ferry daily foot+vehicle crossings (very high volume)

Mombasa -> Watamu/Malindi resort + marine-park belt (Italian-heavy market). Borderline-OK range.
Coastal long-leg to car-free Lamu (water-access-only via Mokowe). Range-gated roadmap leg, NOT an N30 leg.

corridors.thesis: Kenya<->Tanzania cross-border island hop. Geometrically in-range, but CROSS-BORDER (customs/immigration/maritime clearance). Roadmap-only; flag heavily.
